question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\operatorname{arsech}⁡(\sqrt[3]{x})] \\  & =-\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}\sqrt{1-{(\sqrt[3]{x})}^{2}}}\cdot {(\sqrt[3]{x})}^{′} \\  & =-\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}\sqrt{1-\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}}}\cdot \frac{1}{3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{3x\sqrt{1-\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
